title: Workflow Baseline Manifest
description: Per-repo record written by the crow-mind-workflow init-repo skill to .claude/.workflow-baseline.json. It captures which plugin version stamped the repo, the slot values used, and a content hash of every stamped file. The sync-baseline skill diffs a repo against this manifest (and the plugin's current templates) to detect drift.

pluginName.description: Identifier of the plugin that stamped this repo (e.g. "crow-mind-workflow").

pluginVersion.description: Semantic version of the plugin at stamp time. sync-baseline compares this to the installed plugin version to tell whether the repo is behind.

templateSetVersion.description: Version of the template set stamped into the repo. Bumps when the templates change even if the plugin version does not; lets sync-baseline detect template-only drift.

stampedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the baseline was stamped or last updated.

slots.description: The slot values (key -> value) supplied during the init-repo interview and substituted into the templates. Keys match the slot keys defined in templates/slots.yml.

files.description: One entry per file stamped into the repo, recording where it landed, which template it came from, and a content hash for drift detection.

path.description: Repo-relative path of the stamped file (e.g. ".claude/rules/ticketing.md").

template.description: Plugin-relative path of the source template this file was rendered from (e.g. "templates/.claude/rules/ticketing.md").

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the rendered file's content at stamp time. sync-baseline recomputes this to detect local edits.
